QuestInfo.parent: A Gift for a Citizen of Honor
QuestInfo.name: A Craftsman's Touch
QuestInfo.1: #p208# said the #t4031124# is made from a rare wood hardly ever found on Victoria Island, and asked me to gather #t4000050# and #t4000063# as materials to repair the bow. It seems #b#t4000050##k can be obtained from #b#o40##k, #b#o45##k, and #b#o50##k, while #b#t4000063##k can be obtained from monsters imbued with magical energy, such as #b#o47##k, #b#o48##k, and #b#o49##k.  \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 57 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I brought #p208# all the materials needed to repair the bow.

0.0: I took a close look at this #t4031124#, and it seems to be made from a kind of wood I've never seen before — I don't think it comes from any tree found on Victoria Island. Since it's a material I've never worked with, its strength and flexibility are different from what I'm used to, so I have to be all the more careful with it. I'm afraid it won't be easy to repair with ordinary materials.
0.1: But don't worry, it's not impossible. Let's see... if I had #b#t4000050##k and #b#t4000063##k, I think I might be able to make it work somehow. Would you be able to gather these two materials for me?

yes.0: Thank you. You should be able to get #b#t4000050##k from monsters like #o40#, #o45#, and #o50#. As for #b#t4000063##k, that comes from monsters imbued with magical energy — you should be able to find it from ones like #o47#, #o48#, and #o49#. In the meantime, I'll keep researching how to repair this bow.

no.0: Was that too much to ask of you?

1.0: Oh, you're back! And you've brought me all the materials I asked for. I've managed to figure out how to repair the bow while you were gone. Please, just wait a little longer.

item.0: To fix this bow, I'll need #b#t4000050##k and #b#t4000063##k. I'll keep researching how to repair it until you return.
